name: Flux Payments Gateway for WooCommerce
author: nickkreissler59

sections.description:
Unlock Lower Fees and Faster Payments for Your WooCommerce Store

Flux Payments Gateway for WooCommerce allows merchants to accept multiple payment methods including credit cards, ACH bank transfers, and cryptocurrency — all through one simple, secure integration. Reduce transaction fees, eliminate chargeback fraud on crypto payments, and start accepting stablecoins in minutes.

Perfect for: High-volume stores, international merchants, crypto-forward businesses, and anyone looking to reduce payment processing costs.

👉 View 16 Screenshots showing the complete payment flow from customer checkout to merchant dashboard!

🚀 Why Choose Flux Payments?

💰 Save Money on Transaction Fees
Lower processing costs compared to traditional gateways — keep more of your revenue.

🔒 Zero Chargebacks on Crypto Payments
Cryptocurrency transactions are final — eliminate chargeback fraud and save time on disputes.

⚡ Fast & Seamless Setup
Get up and running in under 5 minutes. No complex integrations or lengthy approval processes.

🌍 Accept Global Payments
Support credit cards, ACH, Bitcoin, Ethereum, stablecoins (USDC, USDT), and more — reach customers worldwide.

🔄 Automatic Order Updates
Orders are automatically marked as paid when transactions complete — no manual reconciliation needed.

📦 Smart Product Sync
Your WooCommerce products automatically sync with Flux Payments — one-click bulk sync available.

Key Features → Business Benefits

✅ Multiple Payment Methods → Increase conversion rates by offering customers their preferred payment option
✅ Zero Setup Fees → Start accepting payments immediately with no upfront costs
✅ Secure Hosted Checkout → Reduce PCI compliance burden — customers complete payment on Flux’s secure page
✅ Cryptocurrency Support → Tap into the growing crypto economy and attract tech-savvy customers
✅ Flexible Configuration → Enable/disable payment methods based on your business needs
✅ Real-time Transaction Status → Track payments instantly through your WooCommerce dashboard
✅ Physical & Digital Products → Works with any product type in your WooCommerce catalog

Supported Payment Methods

  • Credit & Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover)
  • ACH Bank Transfers (US-based merchants)
  • Cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDC, USDT, and more)

How It Works

  1. Customer adds products to cart and proceeds to checkout
  2. Selects “Flux Payments” as payment method
  3. Gets redirected to secure Flux Payments hosted page
  4. Completes payment using credit card, ACH, or crypto
  5. Returns to your store with order automatically confirmed
  6. You receive funds directly to your merchant account

Trusted by WooCommerce Merchants

Join the growing community of merchants processing payments through Flux Payments. Learn more at the official Flux Payments website.

Developer Friendly

  • Lightweight code — adds minimal load time to your store
  • Clean integration with WooCommerce payment gateway API
  • Webhooks for real-time order status updates
  • Detailed logging for troubleshooting

For complete documentation, visit Flux Payments Documentation or contact our support team.

Live Demo & Support

🎯 Try Before You Install

Want to see Flux Payments in action? Experience the complete checkout flow:
1. Visit Flux Payments Demo Store to see live transactions
2. Test the payment process from customer perspective
3. See how quickly orders are processed and confirmed

📚 Documentation & Resources

  • Setup Guide – Step-by-step installation instructions at Flux Payments Docs
  • Video Tutorials – Watch setup and configuration videos
  • API Documentation – For developers building custom integrations
  • FAQs – Common questions answered on the official site

💬 Get Support

Need assistance? We’re here to help:
– Plugin Support – Post in the WordPress.org support forums
– Merchant Support – Contact Flux Payments support team directly at fluxpayments.com
– Email Support – Reach out to the merchant services team
– Response Time – Most inquiries answered within 24 hours

🌟 Stay Updated

  • Visit Flux Payments for the latest features and updates
  • Follow development updates and announcements
  • Submit feature requests and feedback

External services

This plugin connects to the Flux Payments API to process payments and manage product synchronization. The plugin relies on external services provided by Flux Payments.

What the service is and what it is used for:
Flux Payments API (https://api.fluxpayments.com) is used to:
– Synchronize WooCommerce products with Flux Payments
– Create payment links for customer transactions
– Process payments via credit card, ACH, and cryptocurrency
– Retrieve transaction status and currency/wallet information

What data is sent and when:
– Product information (name, price, SKU, description, images) is sent when products are created or updated
– Order details (amount, currency, product IDs) are sent when creating payment links
– Transaction IDs are retrieved to verify payment completion
– Customer is redirected to Flux Payments hosted checkout page to complete payment

Service provider information:
This service is provided by Flux Payments. You can find their terms of service and privacy policy at:
– Terms of Service: https://fluxpayments.com/terms-of-use
– Privacy Policy: https://payments.fluxpayments.com/Policy_Privacy.html

See It In Action: Complete Payment Flow Demo

Want to understand exactly how Flux Payments works for your customers and your admin? Here’s a visual walkthrough of the complete process from installation to payment completion:

🛒 Customer Experience: The Checkout Journey

Step 1: Add to Cart
See screenshot #4 – Your customer adds products to their WooCommerce shopping cart just like any other order. The Flux Payments option appears seamlessly alongside your other payment methods.

Step 2: Proceed to Checkout
See screenshot #5 – One click takes them to the checkout page where they can see all available payment options clearly displayed.

Step 3: Review Order Details
See screenshot #6 – On the checkout page, customers see their full order summary including products, shipping, and the option to select Flux Payments as their payment method.

Step 4: Select Flux Payments
See screenshot #1 – Customers choose Flux Payments and can see it supports credit cards, ACH bank transfers, or cryptocurrency — giving them flexibility to pay how they prefer.

Step 5: Enter Shipping Address
See screenshot #7 – Customer enters their shipping information. This data is securely stored for order fulfillment.

Step 6: Redirect to Secure Payment Page
The customer is seamlessly redirected to Flux Payments’ PCI-compliant hosted checkout (see screenshot #8). Your website never handles sensitive payment data — this happens on Flux’s secure servers, reducing your PCI compliance burden.

Step 7: Choose Payment Method
See screenshot #8 – On the Flux secure page, customers choose their preferred payment method: credit card, ACH bank transfer, or select from available cryptocurrencies (Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDC, USDT, and more).

Step 8: Email Verification (Security Feature)
See screenshots #9 and #10 – For added security, customers verify their email address and enter a confirmation code. This prevents fraud and chargebacks while keeping legitimate transactions smooth.

Step 9: Payment Processing
See screenshot #11 – The system processes the payment in real-time. For crypto payments, customers can pay with their preferred digital wallet. For cards and ACH, traditional processing occurs.

Step 10: Return to Your Store
See screenshot #12 – After successful payment, customers are automatically returned to your WooCommerce store and see the order confirmation page. They receive a confirmation email and can track their order status.

👨‍💼 Merchant Experience: Admin & Dashboard

Plugin Configuration – Getting Started
See screenshots #2 and #3 – In your WordPress admin, configure Flux Payments in under 5 minutes:
1. Enter your Flux API key (get it from your merchant dashboard)
2. Enable payment methods you want to accept (credit card, ACH, crypto)
3. Customize the gateway title and description customers see
4. Optionally sync your WooCommerce products to Flux with one click

Order Management
See screenshot #13 – Every order in WooCommerce includes the Flux transaction ID. You can see:
– Payment method used (card, ACH, or crypto type)
– Transaction amount and currency
– Payment status (completed, pending, failed)
– Transaction timestamp

Transaction Tracking in Flux Dashboard
See screenshots #14, #15, and #16 – Log into your Flux Payments merchant dashboard to view:
– Complete Transaction History – See all payments across all payment methods in one place
– Detailed Transaction Info – Payment method, amount, customer details, fees
– Real-time Status – Know instantly when payments are confirmed
– Export & Reporting – Download transaction data for accounting and reporting

🔄 The Complete Flow in 30 Seconds

  1. Customer checkout → Sees Flux Payments as option (screenshot #1)
  2. Redirect to Flux → Secure hosted page loads (screenshot #8)
  3. Customer pays → Chooses credit card, ACH, or crypto
  4. Email verification → Extra security step (screenshots #9, #10)
  5. Payment confirmed → Returns to your store (screenshot #12)
  6. Order updates → You see completed order in WooCommerce (screenshot #13)
  7. Funds received → Settlement to your merchant account
  8. Track everything → Both WooCommerce and Flux dashboard (screenshots #14-16)

✅ Why This Flow is Better Than Standard Payment Methods

For Your Customers:
– ✅ More payment options (crypto + traditional)
– ✅ Secure checkout (PCI-compliant, hosted by Flux)
– ✅ Faster confirmation (especially crypto)
– ✅ Email verification for fraud protection

For You (The Merchant):
– ✅ Lower transaction fees (especially crypto payments)
– ✅ Zero chargeback risk on crypto transactions
– ✅ Automatic order updates (no manual reconciliation)
– ✅ Complete transaction history in one dashboard
– ✅ PCI compliance simplified (payments happen off your server)

For Developers:
– ✅ Clean API integration
– ✅ Real-time webhooks for order status updates
– ✅ Comprehensive logging for debugging
– ✅ Flexible configuration options

This complete visual walkthrough shows you exactly how Flux Payments works from both the customer and merchant perspective. Ready to see it in action? Try the live demo or follow the 5-minute setup guide above!

Performance & Compatibility

Lightning Fast & Lightweight

⚡ Minimal Load Time Impact – The plugin adds less than 20ms to page load time
⚡ Optimized Code – Built following WordPress and WooCommerce coding standards
⚡ Asynchronous Processing – Payment processing happens on Flux’s servers, not yours
⚡ Efficient API Calls – Smart caching reduces unnecessary API requests

Fully Compatible With

✅ WordPress Versions: 5.0 to 6.8+
✅ WooCommerce Versions: 3.0 to 8.5+
✅ PHP Versions: 7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3
✅ MySQL Versions: 5.6+ / MariaDB 10.0+

Works Seamlessly With

  • All major WooCommerce-compatible themes (Storefront, Astra, OceanWP, Kadence, Flatsome, etc.)
  • Popular page builders (Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Beaver Builder)
  • Multi-currency plugins
  • WooCommerce Subscriptions (for non-recurring products)
  • WooCommerce Memberships
  • Translation plugins (WPML, Polylang)

Tested & Verified On

  • Standard WordPress installations
  • WordPress Multisite networks
  • WooCommerce REST API integrations
  • High-traffic stores (1,000+ orders/day)
  • Both HTTP and HTTPS sites (HTTPS recommended)

Server Requirements

  • PHP 7.4 or higher (8.0+ recommended)
  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 3.0 or higher
  • HTTPS/SSL certificate (required for production use)
  • cURL support enabled
  • JSON support enabled
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Flux Payments Gateway”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Click Activate Plugin

Quick Start Setup (Under 5 Minutes)

Step 1: Get Your API Key
– Sign up for a merchant account at Flux Payments
– Log in to your Flux merchant dashboard
– Navigate to API settings and generate your API key

Step 2: Configure the Plugin
– In WordPress, go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments
– Find Flux Payments and click Manage
– Enable the payment gateway
– Paste your Flux API key
– Set your gateway title (e.g., “Credit Card, ACH, or Crypto”)
– Add a customer-facing description

Step 3: Enable Payment Methods
– Check the boxes for payment methods you want to accept:
✓ Credit/Debit Cards
✓ ACH Bank Transfers
✓ Cryptocurrency
– Configure crypto-specific options if enabled

Step 4: Sync Your Products (Optional but Recommended)
– Scroll to the Product Sync section
– Click Sync All Products to Flux to push your catalog
– Products will automatically sync on future updates

Step 5: Test & Go Live
– Save your settings
– Place a test order to verify everything works
– Start accepting payments!

Need help? Visit our support documentation or contact the Flux Payments support team.
sections.faq:
How long does it take to set up?

Most merchants are up and running in under 5 minutes. Just install the plugin, add your API key, enable your preferred payment methods, and you’re ready to accept payments.

Where do I get my Flux API key?

Sign up for a merchant account at Flux Payments. Once logged in to your dashboard, navigate to the API settings section to generate your API key. If you need assistance, contact the Flux Payments support team.

What payment methods are supported?

Flux Payments supports:
– Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover)
– ACH Bank Transfers (US merchants)
– Cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDC, USDT, and more)

You can enable or disable any of these methods in the plugin settings.

Can I disable certain payment methods (e.g., crypto)?

Yes! You have full control over which payment methods to offer. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > Flux Payments and check/uncheck the payment methods you want to enable.

Are there any transaction fees?

Flux Payments charges competitive transaction fees with no setup costs or monthly fees. Crypto transactions typically have lower fees than traditional credit card processing. For detailed pricing, visit Flux Payments pricing or contact their sales team.

Is this plugin secure?

Yes. Customers are redirected to Flux Payments’ PCI-compliant hosted checkout page to complete transactions. This means sensitive payment data never touches your WordPress site, reducing your PCI compliance burden and security risk.

Will this work with my WooCommerce theme?

Yes! The plugin integrates with WooCommerce’s standard payment gateway API, so it works with any properly coded WooCommerce-compatible theme.

Does this plugin support subscriptions or recurring payments?

Not at this time. Subscription and recurring payment support is planned for a future release.

How do refunds work?

Refunds for credit card and ACH transactions can be processed through your Flux Payments merchant dashboard. Note that cryptocurrency transactions are final and cannot be refunded due to the nature of blockchain technology.

Can I use this in test mode?

Yes. Flux Payments provides sandbox/test API keys so you can test the complete checkout flow before going live. Contact Flux Payments support to request test credentials.

What happens if a payment fails?

If a payment fails, the customer is notified immediately and can retry with a different payment method. The WooCommerce order remains in “pending payment” status until successfully completed.

Do I need a Flux Payments merchant account?

Yes. You must sign up for a merchant account at Flux Payments to use this plugin. The signup process is quick and you’ll receive your API key upon approval.

Does this affect my site’s performance?

No. The plugin is lightweight and adds minimal overhead to your WordPress site. The actual payment processing happens on Flux Payments’ servers, not yours.

Can I track transactions in WooCommerce?

Yes! Transaction IDs and payment details are automatically saved to each WooCommerce order. You can view full transaction details in both your WooCommerce order page and your Flux Payments merchant dashboard.

What WooCommerce versions are supported?

This plugin is compatible with WooCommerce 3.0 and higher. It has been tested up to WooCommerce 8.5.

Need more help?

Visit the Flux Payments support documentation or contact their support team for personalized assistance. For plugin-specific issues, you can also post in the WordPress.org support forums.
